reason: The prior provisional Four-regiment-scale 3rd Tank Division armor wallet can double-count the 8th Tank Regiment, which is independently anchored in the South Pacific/Rabaul OOB by Nov 1942.

source_conflict_note.nominal_division: Secondary organizational tables often list 8th, 12th, 13th and 17th Tank Regiments under the 3rd Tank Division.
source_conflict_note.physical_branch: A Nov-1942 17th/8th Area Army OOB independently places the 8th Tank Regiment at Rabaul. Physical location overrides nominal paper organization.
source_conflict_note.resolution: Treat 8th as detached before/while the 3rd Tank Division formation is completed. Branch Five-Go has a three-regiment armored core unless a replacement regiment is explicitly created and paid for; none is currently evidenced.

1943_03_25_launch_working_band.guard: This is still a formation reconstruction, not a regiment-by-regiment archival return.

difference_from_previous_provisional.new: roughly 195-240 total tracked AFVs including reconnaissance, with only three tank regiments
difference_from_previous_provisional.delta: about 50-80 fewer physical tracked AFVs at Five-Go launch than the earlier provisional upper-scale assumption
difference_from_previous_provisional.strategic_result: Does not automatically reopen Five-Go strategic outcome; the current authoritative campaign already limits medium tanks south of Baoji/Qinling and remains logistics-bound.

Phase_I_first_pass_damage_gate.reason: Long road/rail-supported plains offensive generates high tank-days and real Chinese AT/artillery exposure; Branch recovery prevents many disabled vehicles becoming national losses.

Phase_II_Qinling_rule.medium_tank_main_body: HOLD NORTH / road-security and mobile reserve
Phase_II_Qinling_rule.role: light/selected medium packets, engineer support, road-junction fire support; not a tank-division mountain thrust
Phase_II_Qinling_rule.effect: Most surviving division armor remains a physical China-theater asset after Hanzhong rather than being consumed in the mountains.

systemic_reaudit_needed: Recompute Japanese infantry/artillery/engineer casualties saved in the plains phase from explicit tank-days.
Recompute Chinese infantry/AT/artillery losses caused by the corrected 195-240 AFV pool.
Reconcile Phase-I damaged vehicles with 1943 repair pipeline and year-end residual.
Do not alter the authoritative Hanzhong dates until this combat-layer audit shows a material timing difference.
immediate_residual_consequence: Any 1943-12-31 national/tactical armor ledger must subtract the entire 8th Tank Regiment into South Pacific and use the three-regiment Five-Go core before adding 1943 new production or repairs.
